title: 第97章 六斤的野生老鳖，赚大了

第97章 六斤的野生老鳖，赚大了-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

时间一分一秒流逝！

早晨五点多，小船缓缓靠了岸，板车上已经堆满了大量的渔获，李青山在上面盖了一层水草，然后将电瓶放上去，大概估测一下，今日的收获大概有五百多斤，和昨天差不多。

四个人……哦不，三个人……！

三个人推着板车，李青山走在前面，顺着沙河朝着土乡的方向赶去，这一路上还有李青山下的老鳖地笼子。

“停下！”

李青山走到第一个老鳖地笼子后，便上前蹲下身去，拽住插在河岸上的木棍，将捆绑着的绳子朝着岸边上拖拽。

“山哥，你这竹子编的笼子装鸡还行，能抓到老鳖吗？”大壮有些质疑的开口问道。

这个时候，第一个地笼子也拽了上来。

嗯，空空如也。

李青山将其丢在板车渔获上面，继续朝着前面走，大壮顿时不说话了。

然后是第二个地笼子。

李青山对这个地笼子的期望很高，因为这环境就适合老鳖，绳子刚刚入手，就能够感觉到有些重量。

哎……！

心中一喜，连忙继续用力向上拉。

地笼子出水，发出哗啦啦的声响，大量的河水重新落了回去，溅起朵朵水花。

一道黄色的身影出现在地笼子里面。

老鳖！

抓到了。

“我勒个去，这装鸡的笼子，还真的能抓到甲鱼啊？”大壮瞪大眼睛，满是震惊道。

“什么装鸡的笼子，没听山哥说吗，这是老鳖笼，也叫地笼子，不过，这什么地笼子，咱们以前还真的没见过，山哥，这是你自己发明的吗？”

赵红旗好奇道。

“算是吧！”

李青山点了点头，这种形式的地笼子捕获甲鱼的办法，好像还真的没有出现，根据记载第一次出现也要几年后了。

“山哥，你脑子也太聪明了，不仅仅能电鱼，还能用竹子做的笼子抓甲鱼，真是厉害。”

“是啊，而且还抓到了。”

“这甲鱼，至少得有五斤重吧？”

“我记得昨天那个林业站的说，一斤给咱们山哥五毛钱呢，这五斤重的老鳖，岂不是一只就能卖到两块五毛钱？”

Time passes minute by minute!

At around five o'clock in the morning, the boat slowly docked, and the cart was already piled with a large amount of fish. Li Qingshan covered it with a layer of water plants, and then put the battery on it. By rough estimation, today's harvest was about 500 kilograms, which was similar to yesterday.

Four people...oh no, three people...!

The three people pushed the cart, with Li Qingshan walking in front, heading towards Tuxiang along the Shahe River. Along the way, there was also the old turtle's cage under Li Qingshan.

"Stop!"

Li Qingshan walked to the first old turtle cage, squatted down, grabbed the wooden stick inserted on the river bank, and dragged the tied rope toward the bank.

"Brother Shan, your bamboo cage is okay for holding chickens. Can you catch the old turtle?" Da Zhuang asked doubtfully.

At this time, the first cage was also pulled up.

Well, nothing.

Li Qingshan threw it on the cart and continued walking forward. Da Zhuang suddenly stopped talking.

Then there is the second ground cage.

Li Qingshan had high expectations for this ground cage, because the environment was suitable for the old turtle, and he could feel the weight of the rope as soon as he got it.

Why……!

Feeling happy, I quickly continued to pull upward.

Water came out of the underground cage, making a splashing sound, and a large amount of river water fell back again, causing splashes.

A yellow figure appeared inside the underground cage.

Old turtle!

Got it.

"Let me tell you, can this chicken cage really catch turtles?" Da Zhuang said with wide eyes, full of shock.

"What's a chicken cage? Didn't you hear what Brother Shan said? This is an old turtle cage, also called a ground cage. However, we have never seen a cage like this before. Brother Shan, did you invent this yourself?"

Zhao Hongqi asked curiously.

"So be it!"

Li Qingshan nodded. This method of catching turtles in ground cages seems to have not really appeared yet. According to records, it would be a few years before it first appeared.

"Brother Shan, you are so smart. Not only can you electrocute fish, but you can also catch turtles with a cage made of bamboo. It's really amazing."

"Yeah, and I caught him."

"This turtle must weigh at least five kilograms, right?"

"I remember yesterday that the person from the forestry station said that he would give our mountain brother 50 cents per pound. Wouldn't a five-pound old turtle be sold for two dollars and fifty cents each?"
